tasks.title: Inside a jamming field the player cannot fire H abilities or K rockets, and gets them back a moment after leaving; movement, boost, dash and the main gun never change
tasks.description: Build the player-side ability lock before any enemy uses it. PlayerBase (global/entities/player_base.gd) gains ability_lock_changed(locked: bool), ability_press_refused(), apply_ability_lock(seconds, source), abilities_locked(), ability_lock_fill(), allow_ability_press() and a _step_ability_lock(delta) called at the top of _step_disruption(). The field is sampled by the body: HazardInfo gains stabilise_seconds, HazardField gains exports disables_abilities (true only while ACTIVE) and stabilise_seconds, Hazards gains jammer_at(pos). One allow_ability_press() check goes into each of the three seams: OpenSpacePlayerShip._input, PlayerFighter._input and RocketState._on_action (special_weapon only, after the cooldown check, before launch and cooldown start). WeaponState is not edited. Tests first: tests/integration/test_player_ability_lock.gd on both real player scenes plus the jammer_at rows in tests/unit/test_hazards.gd, using a plain HazardField as the jammer.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: All rows of plan §2.2 pass in both real player scenes: lock on the first tick inside; unlocked exactly at T+45 after a 0.75 s exit (locked at T+44); re-entry restarts the delay; pulsed TELEGRAPH/QUIET count as outside; a freed field starts the delay; timed locks longest-wins with no stabilisation; every H module and both K rocket types refused while locked with nothing spent and the event handled; switch_weapon still works; module cooldowns keep ticking; primary fire for all five weapon modes and movement verbs bit-identical inside a lit field; no Hazards.jammer_at call with no hazard registered. Every existing player, hazard and module test unchanged and green. GUT delta reported (allotment 2.0 s). verify.sh green.

tasks.title: The player sees when their abilities are jammed: a static crackle on the ship, a JAMMED chip with a refill bar on the HUD and a lock over the rocket icon, plus a hook for later sound
tasks.description: Add the AbilityLockStatic overlay (code-built on PlayerBase like BoostDisruptionRing), the JammedChip and LockGlyph in the shared MissionHud (global/ui/mission_hud.gd, both HUD scenes), the refused-press flash, and the EventBus signals player_ability_lock_changed(locked: bool) (emitted by PlayerBase on each lock edge) and player_ordnance_hijacked(rocket: Node2D, source: Node) (declared here, emitted later by the homing missile). No audio player. Tests in tests/integration/test_player_ability_lock_tells.gd.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Overlay and chip visible on the lock tick and hidden on the unlock tick in both ships; the chip bar tracks ability_lock_fill() within 1 px; a refused press flashes the chip; EventBus.player_ability_lock_changed fires once per edge with the right value; the HUD with no player shows nothing and logs no error; signal arity gate green. GUT delta reported (allotment 0.5 s). verify.sh green.

Nothing else about the rocket changes. Tests in tests/integration/test_homing_missile_lifetime.gd (both harnesses) and an ownership row in test_player_bullet_lifetime.gd.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: An Open Space rocket launched far from the origin lives and reaches its target; an Assault rocket expires once on leaving the world rect, at 6.0 s and at 2400 px; both player rocket scenes have exactly one owner; test_armor_query.gd, test_hazard_projectiles.gd, the Ram plate rows and test_enemy_rockets.gd unchanged and green. GUT delta reported (allotment 0.8 s). verify.sh green.

tasks.title: A homing rocket can be taken over: it flashes amber, turns slowly back toward the player and bursts for a small blast, can be shot down or lured into an enemy, and flies straight inside a jammer
tasks.description: Build the seeking-ordnance retarget contract and the hijacked flight mode, pinned with a fixture claimer before any Hacker exists. New global/components/seeking_ordnance.gd (SeekingOrdnance.GROUP, eligible()). homing_missile joins the group and implements can_be_retargeted(), retarget(target, seconds, source) (seconds < 0 uses its own hijack_seconds), is_retargeted(), jam_guidance(source), signals retargeted(source: Node) and retarget_ended(); emits EventBus.player_ordnance_hijacked. Hijacked flight: turn-limited Steering.turn_toward at hijack_turn_rate 1.6, speed eases to 380, 2.5 s window then fizzle, ContactBlast-only player damage (18, r 40) after arming (0.25 s and 60 px clearance), full damage to enemies, a shoot-down HurtBox (512/64) enabled only while hijacked, fizzle at once when the source is freed, amber tell and target bracket. Seekers inside a lit jammer field (Hazards.jammer_at) fly straight, hijacked or not. All tuning as exports on homing_missile.tscn. Tests in tests/integration/test_seeking_ordnance.gd, both harnesses, blast rows on both real player scenes.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: All rows of plan §2.5 pass: group and refusals (warheads never eligible), per-tick turn bounded by hijack_turn_rate, speed 500 to 380, exactly 18 blast damage and never 100, arming rule, fizzle at 2.5 s with no blast, source death fizzles, the lure deals 100 to an enemy, one bullet shoots it down, jammed rockets fly straight, the Open Space and Assault dodge rows (with a stationary control that is hit), primary fire bit-identical during a hijack, EventBus emit once per claim. No new collision bit (test_collision_layer_names.gd green). GUT delta reported (allotment 2.5 s). verify.sh green.

tasks.title: EMP really disrupts: it locks the player's abilities as well as their boost, makes homing rockets lose their lock, and briefly stops enemy ships attacking while they can still be shot
tasks.description: Replace the Phase 7 stand-in in PlayerBase.apply_emp with boost disruption plus apply_ability_lock (signature, is_emp_disrupted and emp_changed unchanged). Extend EmpPulse.emit with a defaulted trailing targets bitmask (TARGET_PLAYER 1, TARGET_ENEMIES 2, TARGET_SEEKERS 4, TARGET_ALL 7); existing calls stay bit-identical. Add BaseEnemy.apply_emp(seconds, source) / is_emp_disrupted() for brain-driven, unsuspended ships only (brain tick skipped, mover still steps after halt(), EmpStatic overlay, stays tangible), the EnemyBrain.on_emp_started() virtual, overrides in TwinLaserDroneBrain (collapse the pair) and LaserTenderBrain (cancel a launch telegraph). EnemyRocket joins enemy_seeking_ordnance in launch() when it steers and answers jam_guidance(). The EMP mine passes TARGET_PLAYER|TARGET_SEEKERS when enemy-laid and TARGET_ALL when placed. Tests: test_emp_pulse.gd additions, new tests/integration/test_enemy_emp.gd (both harnesses), player rows in test_player_ability_lock.gd / test_player_boost_disruption.gd.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: All rows of plan §2.6 pass: existing test_emp_pulse.gd rows untouched and green; TARGET_ENEMIES radius boundary; player EMP of 2.0 s locks abilities for exactly 120 ticks with no stabilisation and still refuses boosts; an EMP'd Fighter fires nothing for the window, coasts, resumes, and is killed by a real player bullet during it; a structure and a railed enemy are unaffected; a twin pair collapses when one drone is EMP'd; seekers lose guidance and DUMB rockets are unchanged; enemy-laid EMP mines never reach enemies, placed ones do; the on_emp_started sweep row passes. Every Ph7 EMP row green. GUT delta reported (allotment 2.0 s). verify.sh green.

tasks.acceptanceCriteria: All rows of plan §2.8 and §2.9 pass: per-variant info (kind, avoid 0, radius, stabilisation, pulsed phases 0.8/3.0/2.5, disables_abilities only in ACTIVE), config and scene values match; a real ship inside is locked and the lock ends 0.75 s after the jammer is shot dead from inside; Assault drift, free and world-anchored x; a Fighter's path is unchanged by a jammer; enemy Pursuit rockets fly straight inside and steer after; corvette downgrade with an outside control; every roster gate green with the three new directories.
